issue.description:
AGENTS.md's compatibility section states 'Unknown JSON fields must survive import/export round trips' as a hard rule, but no open bead covers verifying it. Add a conformance suite that writes checkpoints carrying unknown extra fields at every object level (issue, event, dependency, external ref, structured data, resource key, receipt, pointer/current.json), re-imports via the native restore path (restore-into-empty), re-exports, and asserts semantic preservation across generations — including through the redaction and stale-event-merge paths that rewrite historical events. Silent field dropping on the recovery path is data loss invisible to every diagnostic, and this needs locking down before the in-flight migration and redaction work lands.

issue.description:
Context: NEEDLE ADR-022 (docs/adr/022-…) and Phase 19 §19.2 of NEEDLE's plan. NEEDLE will stop setting `--status blocked`, but a human-set block must still be visible, and NEEDLE's migration (needle-e0e11ed8) needs to enumerate blocked beads without calling `bead why --id` per bead.

## Observed (2026-08-29)
`manual_blocked` is an overlay: `bead list --json`, `bead show`, and `bead doctor ready_frontier` all report such a bead as plain `open`; only `bead why --id` prints `Manual Blocked: true`. `bead list --status blocked` is rejected ("Unknown status: blocked"). 171 open beads across 13 workspaces carried the flag invisibly; warden and sun-sim were fully starved with no visible cause.

## Task
1. `bead list --json` and `bead show` emit `manual_blocked: true|false` (and `effective_status: blocked` when set).
2. `bead list --blocked` filters to manually blocked open beads (accept `--status blocked` as an alias that maps to the same filter rather than erroring).
3. `bead doctor` ready_frontier check reports the count of manually blocked open beads as a WARN line.
4. Docs: cli.rs help text and README mention the flag.

## Done when
Fixture: `bead update X --status blocked` then `bead list --blocked --json | jq -r .id` prints X; `bead show X` contains `Manual Blocked: true`; `bead doctor` prints `WARN … 1 open issue manually blocked`; `bead list --status blocked` exits 0 with the same row. Round-trips through checkpoint flush/import.
issue.title: Surface manual_blocked in list/show/doctor and add a --blocked filter to bead list

issue.close_reason: Rejected by proposal triage (test/coverage proposal not tied to a dated defect); rule proposal-triage-2026-10-23.1. Reopen to reconsider.
issue.description:
AGENTS.md requires every mutating operation to be atomic, auditable, and concurrency-tested, and ADR-003's dirtiness contract requires every committed semantic mutation to advance the live event sequence. Open beads emit audit events for create_issue, dependency, external-reference, and structured-data mutations, but other mutating paths — resource-key add/remove, labels, assignee/status updates — have no visible coverage bead. Work: sweep the remaining public mutation APIs for event emission, emit audit events for any that advance state without one (mirroring the shape of the existing four audit-event beads), and add round-trip checkpoint coverage and concurrency tests so the dirtiness contract holds for every mutation, not just the enumerated ones.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Close audit-event coverage for mutation paths not named by ADR-003's follow-up beads
